name: list_spice_datasets
description: List QuickSight SPICE datasets in an AWS account and region. Returns dataset IDs, names, and SPICE capacity consumed in bytes.

name: scan_unused_columns
description: Scan one or more SPICE datasets for unused columns without making any changes (read-only analysis). Returns a job ID; poll get_job_result until the job completes. The report explains why each retained column is protected, naming the specific dashboard, analysis, or child dataset that requires it.

dataset_ids.description: List of QuickSight dataset IDs to scan

safety_threshold_pct.description: Maximum fraction of columns that may be removed before the operation halts. Between 0.0 and 1.0. Defaults to 0.7.

quarantine_period_days.description: Number of days a column must be continuously unused before it becomes eligible for removal. Omit to disable the quarantine gate.

name: remove_unused_columns
description: Remove unused columns from SPICE datasets. This modifies the dataset. A full snapshot is written to S3 first so the change can be rolled back. Always run scan_unused_columns first and get explicit user confirmation before calling this. Returns a job ID; poll get_job_result until the job completes.

dataset_ids.description: List of QuickSight dataset IDs to modify

action.description: Must be the literal string "remove". An explicit confirmation that the caller intends to modify the dataset, not merely analyse it.

safety_threshold_pct.description: Maximum fraction of columns that may be removed before the operation halts. Between 0.0 and 1.0. Defaults to 0.7.

quarantine_period_days.description: Number of days a column must be continuously unused before it becomes eligible for removal. Omit to disable the quarantine gate.

cascade_child_refresh.description: After removing columns and refreshing this dataset, also trigger a SPICE refresh for every descendant (child) dataset, parents before children. Prevents child dashboards from showing stale data or errors against the new parent schema. Off by default; a child that cannot be refreshed (e.g. an uploaded-file source) is reported, not treated as a failure.

name: get_job_result
description: Poll the status of a scan or remove job. Returns status "running", "completed", or "failed". When completed, includes the summary and the S3 key of the full optimisation report. Poll every 10 seconds while running.

job_id.description: The job ID returned by scan_unused_columns or remove_unused_columns

name: list_snapshots
description: List the restorable snapshots for a dataset, newest first. Read-only. Snapshots are written automatically by remove_unused_columns before it changes anything. Call this before rollback_dataset so you can tell the user what would be restored and when it was captured.

dataset_id.description: The QuickSight dataset ID to list snapshots for

name: rollback_dataset
description: Restore a dataset from a snapshot, undoing a previous column removal. This OVERWRITES the dataset's current definition, so any change made since the snapshot is lost. Runs synchronously and returns when the restore is done. Always call list_snapshots first and confirm with the user which snapshot to restore before calling this.

dataset_id.description: The QuickSight dataset ID to restore

action.description: Must be the literal string "rollback". An explicit confirmation that the caller intends to overwrite the dataset's current definition.

snapshot_key.description: Optional S3 key of a specific snapshot from list_snapshots. Omit to restore the most recent.

trigger_refresh.description: Whether to start a SPICE refresh after restoring. Defaults to true; restored columns hold no data until the dataset refreshes.
